{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: The PBS script contains placeholders (<walltime>, <memory>, <out_folder>, <project_home>, <cfg_file>, <aargs>).
#       These must be filled in before a correct Flux resource request can be expressed.
#
#       Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources (original):
#   -N analysis
#   -q batch
#   -l walltime=<walltime>
#   -l pmem=<memory>
#   -l nodes=1:ppn=1
#   -o "<out_folder>/${PBS_JOBID}.out"
#   -j oe

#flux: --job-name=analysis
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1

# Omitted PBS option: -l walltime=<walltime>
# Cannot translate because walltime is unspecified.
# Performance implication: Flux will use a default time limit which may be too short (job killed) or too long (lower priority).

# Omitted PBS option: -l pmem=<memory>
# Cannot translate because memory is unspecified (and Flux memory requests are site/config dependent).
# Performance implication: job may be under-provisioned and be OOM-killed.

# Omitted PBS option: -q batch (queue)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run with different limits/priority or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted PBS options: -o .../${PBS_JOBID}.out and -j oe
# PBS_JOBID is not available under Flux and portable stdout/stderr joining is not guaranteed.
# Performance implication: none on runtime performance, but log naming/collection differs.

cd "${FLUX_JOB_SUBMIT_DIR:-$PWD}"

PROJECT_HOME="<project_home>"

PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_HOME/libs:$PYTHONPATH"
export PYTHONPATH

if [ -d "$PROJECT_HOME/venv" ]; then
  . "$PROJECT_HOME/venv/bin/activate"
  echo "Virtualenv at $PROJECT_HOME/venv activated."
else
  echo "WARNING: Virtualenv not found/activated! Using system python & LAMMPS..."
fi

python "$PROJECT_HOME/tools/dump_processing.py" "<cfg_file>" <aargs>
"
}
